parties.petitioner: M/s Tamil Nadu Cements Corporation Limited
parties.respondent: Micro and Small Enterprises Facilitation Council and Another

summary: Maintainability of writ under Article 226 vs statutory arbitration under MSMED Act, s.18; conflict between judicial precedents on conciliation and arbitration by same body; applicability of A&C Act, s.80; override of private arbitration agreements; jurisdictional challenge under s.2(n); deposit requirement under MSMED s.19 for challenge; reference to larger bench due to conflicting judgments.
final_judgment: Issue referred to a larger bench due to conflict between judgments in Jharkhand Urja Vikas Nigam Limited and Gujarat State Civil Supplies Corporation Limited; no final determination on maintainability of writ petition.
